passages.text: When private guides and Gemini are enabled, signed-in learners can choose a coding topic, starting and target levels, learning goals and explanation preferences. Trace requests a structured guide, validates it and saves the result privately to that account. Ready guides can be opened again from Your lessons. A provider failure or invalid response is shown as unavailable, not as a completed guide. Do not include personal information, credentials or private code in a request.

A private guide contains progressive explanations, suggested examples, optional practice and learning outcomes to aim for. Examples are not executed and practice is ungraded. A guide does not complete a verified coding lesson, assign a competency score or create a daily exercise assignment. The reader's scratch notes are not saved or sent. Verified Notes and Tasks lessons remain separate.
